prompt: Write a Move module for minting NFTs on Sui. The mint function should be composable — it returns the NFT so callers can decide what to do with it (transfer, wrap, add to a collection). Include a separate transfer helper. Include tests.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
All tests pass with sui move test
Mint function returns the NFT instead of transferring it internally
NFT struct has key and store abilities for composability

prompt: Build a Move module for a simple shop on Sui. The shop is a shared object created in init. A buy_item function accepts Coin<SUI> payment and returns the purchased ShopItem — the caller's PTB handles where it goes. Include an event for purchases.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
buy_item function returns ShopItem instead of transferring internally
Shop is shared via transfer::share_object in init
Purchase event is emitted with copy, drop abilities
Coin<SUI> payment is accepted and deposited into shop balance
